system.description:
You expand your body like a balloon retracting your arms and legs inside your fat. You use your Chakra to spin your body like a bowling ball, hurling yourself in a towards a target creature and crushing everything else in your way.

Select a creature whose space you can reach and occupy with your movement. Move yourself into the space of the target and make a melee Taijutsu attack against them.

On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + 2d12, but don’t add your ability modifier. The target creature is moved to the closest space of your choice within 5 feet that it can occupy.

Creatures in your path, whom you pass through must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d12 bludgeoning damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one. You can only affect a creature once per casting with this jutsu.

Expansion Crash. If you score a critical hit, or creatures fail their saving throw by 5 or more, affected creatures become Staggered.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the Chakra cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher increase the calorie cost by +1 and your hair grows and becomes spikes as the damage type becomes piercing and you add your ability modifier to the damage. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, if you roll over the same creature 2 or more times as part of the same movement with this jutsu, when you roll the damage dice, you can select which dice you want to reroll, keeping the second result.
